judged_text: onSuccess resets multiEmailValue but never clears isInvalidEmail, and the Dialog's onOpenChange close path resets neither, so the validation-error state outlives both a successful submission and a dialog close. A user who triggers 'Emails must be unique and valid', fixes the addresses, and adds guests successfully watches the mutation complete with the red error banner still on screen beside the success toast, and reopening the dialog later still shows the stale error.

adjudication.rationale: In `AddGuestsDialog`, `isInvalidEmail` is set to `true` on validation failure (`handleAdd`), but it is never reset on successful mutation: `onSuccess` only calls `setIsOpenDialog(false)` and `setMultiEmailValue([""])` (no `setIsInvalidEmail(false)`). Also, the dialog close path via `<Dialog open={isOpenDialog} onOpenChange={setIsOpenDialog}>` will toggle `isOpenDialog` without clearing `isInvalidEmail` or `multiEmailValue`, so closing/reopening the dialog can retain the stale error banner. Only the explicit Cancel button clears `isInvalidEmail`.
